Your experience

A little direction.
A lot of you.

A love story session can mark an engagement, an anniversary or a chapter that needs no occasion at all. We choose a place that feels right, plan around the light, and leave room for walking, talking and the unplanned moments in between.

Amsterdam offers an intimate city backdrop; The Hague and the coast give us space and softer horizons. Couples sessions are available throughout the Netherlands. Your own neighbourhood or a meaningful place is always a good starting point.

Thoughtfully considered.
  • A location and mood chosen together
  • Gentle guidance, with room for natural movement
  • Colour grading consistent with the story
  • An edited selection, with delivery agreed in advance

Before we begin

A few things
you may wonder.

Is this suitable for an engagement or proposal?

Yes, we can discuss an engagement session or plan photography around a proposal. For a surprise, send the details privately in advance so we can work out the practicalities.

What should we wear?

Choose clothes you feel comfortable moving in. Textures and a considered colour palette often work well with my editing. Once we know the location and season, we can discuss outfits together.

Can we book a love story in Den Haag?

Yes. We can discuss a city walk in The Hague or a session towards the coast, depending on your preferred atmosphere, the light and access to the location.

What happens if the weather changes?

We’ll discuss a weather plan before the session. A different time, a sheltered location or a new date may make sense; any changes are agreed together.
